title: Recipe 48 — Harness Designer (the meta-recipe: an agent that writes specs)

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “The compiler's own dogfood: a harness whose job is designing harnesses.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — the committed designer is never touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env — the designer interviews you on a live model.

beats.label: Open the committed designer
beats.cue: “Three hundred lines, and every one of them is instructions. The designer has no special compiler privileges.”

beats.label: Lint it in place
beats.cue: “Same lint as every other spec. The thing that writes specs is itself just a spec.”

beats.label: Show the lowered IR
beats.cue: “One agent, one chat loop. All the intelligence is in the prompt, which is exactly the point.”

beats.label: Open the IR
beats.cue: “Nothing exotic. The designer earns its output the same way any agent does.”

beats.label: Compile the bundle — and check it
beats.cue: “--check: GREEN, gated at the model credential. The designer is a shippable bundle like everything else.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok; install ok; boot gated at the provider credentials gate

beats.label: Run the static recipe gate
beats.cue: “The designer's own claim is that its output compiles. This is the gate that would catch it lying — every spec fence in every recipe, compiled.”

verify.note: every recipe validated: links resolve, spec fences compile, bun scripts exist

beats.label: Read the result
beats.cue: “A designer that emits specs is only as trustworthy as the gate that checks them.”

beats.label: Launch the designer
beats.cue: [needs-key] “It opens by asking what you want to build. Answer in a sentence.”

verify.note: interactive REPL; needs a live model credential

beats.label: Describe a harness
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Watch it pick a target shape and justify the choice before writing a line of YAML.”
beats.text: I want an agent that reads our support inbox and drafts replies for a human to approve.

beats.label: Push back on it
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Step 3's worked dialogues: disagreeing with it is part of the design loop.”
beats.text: Approvals have to be durable — a reviewer might come back a day later. Does that change the shape?

beats.label: Read the optimize handoff
beats.cue: “Step 5: the spec the designer hands you is the input to recipe 42's loop. Design, then optimize.”
